children: Greenland Energy announced indicative terms for an all-share merger to acquire 80 Mile, valuing 80 Mile's issued share capital at £61.48 million.
Greenland Energy proposes an all-share acquisition: 0.01108 Greenland Energy share per 80 Mile share.
Transaction values 80 Mile at £61.48m (≈1.1p per share), implying premiums of ~43%–64% vs recent 80 Mile prices.
Greenland Energy holds 246,765,352 80 Mile shares (4.42%); highest 3-month purchase price 0.82p sets minimum offer price rule.
Proposal subject to confirmatory due diligence, unanimous independent directors' recommendation and other customary pre-conditions.
Greenland Energy intends potential post-offer warrants at $1.50 per share for existing Greenland Energy shareholders only.
